title: Saudi Arabian Gouda Kebabs
description: A delicious and flavorful kebab recipe featuring roasted Gouda cheese and a hint of Saudi Arabian spices.

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: ground cumin for a warm, earthy flavor

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.notes: ground coriander for a citrusy note

instructions: Cut the Gouda cheese into 1-inch cubes.
In a small bowl, mix together paprika, cumin, coriander, garlic powder, and salt.
Brush the bell peppers and onions with olive oil and sprinkle with the spice mixture.
Thread the coated vegetables, Gouda cheese, and any additional desired toppings onto skewers.
Place the kebabs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the vegetables are tender.
Serve warm with bread, if desired.
